author: reek
body: Serpentine and trombone length tuning for matched-length and time-domain tuned nets. Generates meander patterns to add length to traces that are shorter than their target.

author: reek
body: Calculate the number of meander periods needed to add a given length. Each full period adds approximately 2 * amplitude of extra trace length.

author: reek
body: For differential pairs, the shorter trace needs meanders to match the longer trace. The skew is the length difference.
